history_pair.H0: generation g3 is current and no g4 transition ever occurred
history_pair.H1: generation advanced to g4 and the entire repository-visible authority state was later restored to the exact g3 snapshot

tested_scope.stateless_discovery_rule: A future invocation may use only the restored current repository state plus explicitly supplied witness state. Merely retaining a newer object does not count unless its address/existence is statelessly discoverable from those allowed observations.

public_source_evidence.observation: Git commit object names are content hashes; commits identify parent commits and reachability follows the parent chain backward from a known commit. Named branch/tag pointers select history. This supplies integrity and backward reachability for known objects, not an independent freshness oracle after a pointer/state rollback.

observations: For all four constructions, after an exact whole-domain restore the current g3 object/anchor/key state is byte-for-byte compatible with H0; backward links prove ancestors but do not reveal an unreferenced future transition.
A rollback-local forward index or mutable current anchor is restored with the rest of the domain, so it does not distinguish H0 from H1.

Key evolution stored only inside the same rollback domain is also restored to the old key epoch; forward-security properties do not create a freshness observation when the verifier is stateless and its trusted key/epoch state is rolled back with the repository.

A rollback-surviving monotonic floor/incarnation witness distinguishes H0 from H1 in every corresponding fixture cell, but the distinguishing power is supplied by that nonrollback witness rather than by the self-certifying chain itself.
inference: Within this finite paired-history model, self-certification, backward hash chaining, mutable forward links, or locally stored key evolution cannot let a future stateless scheduled-Chat invocation detect a complete rollback of every observable authority value. Detection requires at least one statelessly discoverable freshness/incarnation fact that survives outside the rollback equivalence class, or an authoritative sink that refuses generations below such a surviving lower bound.
scope_guard: This is an indistinguishability result for the enumerated observation model, not a claim that all forward-secure signature systems or all Git hosting products are rollback-unsafe. A product exposing a rollback-surviving, statelessly discoverable monotonic witness would be outside the no-witness cells and must be tested separately.

phase1_acceptance.reason: Every successful distinguishing cell depends on a rollback-surviving witness not yet established inside the authorized zero-quota scheduled-Chat repository path.
